_comment: Tool: search_imports(package, sha) -> [{file, line, statement}]. Walks the repo tree at `sha`, fetches every .py file, and regex-matches `import X` / `from X import ...`. Requires a 'GitHub PAT' generic Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <PAT>) attached to both HTTP Request nodes -- create it in n8n's Credentials UI first, then select it on each node (the credential name/id is NOT set in this JSON, since credentials aren't portable across n8n instances). Replace OWNER/REPO in the first HTTP Request's URL. Test standalone with input {"package": "pyyaml", "sha": "<your demo repo's head sha>"}.
name: AutoRelease Tool - search_imports

parameters.url: =https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{{ $('When called as a tool').first().json.repo || 'adithyashetty39-lang/stormbreakers-demo' }}/{{ $('When called as a tool').first().json.sha }}/{{ $json.path }}
